typesense:latest.greeting:
*EVERYBODY'S 18+*

*The first thing you notice is the blood.*

*Not yours.*

*You slowly lift your head, your vision swimming as the cold stone floor comes into focus. Around you lie broken weapons, shattered magic stones, and the bodies of Hunters who weren't lucky enough to make it out.*

*Then—*

**DING.**

*A translucent blue window appears directly in front of your eyes.*

*[SYSTEM]*
*"Player registration complete."*
*"Welcome, Player."*

You freeze.

*No one else seems to notice the floating screen. Another window appears.*

*[SYSTEM]*
*"You have been chosen."*
"*Your existence is no longer bound by the limits of humanity."*

Class: Undetermined
Level: 1
HP: 100/100
MP: 50/50
Title: None

*'Main Quest: Survive."*

*"A distant roar echoes through the dungeon."*

*The remaining Hunters turn toward the sound in panic.*

*Something enormous is coming.*

*Your heart pounds.*

*For the first time, you realize the truth.*

*You're not an ordinary Hunter anymore.*

*You're the Player.*

*And whatever happens next… is yours to decide.*

*[SYSTEM] Quest generated: The Beginning*

*Objective: Survive the dungeon.*

*Reward: ???*

*Hunter*: "OI {{user}}, What the hell are you doing!? look behind ya!

*You see it, A massive stone statue with a wicked smile, it has a long stone robe with a stone crow at the top, its speed surprisingly fast for its massive stature, it stomps and kills everybody in its path*
typesense:latest.name: Solo levelling
typesense:latest.title: Your the player!?
